definitions.explanation: The medical or formal term for nasal mucus or discharge. Used in clinical contexts. In everyday speech, {鼻水|はなみず} is far more common.

examples.japanese: {鼻汁|びじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鼻汁|びじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{細菌感染|さいきんかんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{疑|うたが}った→疑う：01889_utagau⟧。
examples.english: The doctor suspected a bacterial infection from the color of the nasal discharge.

examples.japanese: {鼻汁|びじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{陽性|ようせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A nasal discharge test revealed a positive result for influenza.

notes:
Medical and formal equivalent of ⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧. Found in medical records, clinical descriptions, and formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鼻汁|びじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: nasal discharge appears
- ⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧{鼻汁|びじゅう}: yellow nasal discharge (sign of infection)
- {水様性|すいようせい}{鼻汁|びじゅう}: watery nasal discharge
- {鼻汁|びじゅう}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: nasal discharge test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧: runny nose — the standard everyday term
